name: Mihai Popescu
bio:
Mihai's journey into motorsport began in his youth, tinkering with Lada engines in his father's garage. This early fascination led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering, after which he joined a small rally team. Over the years, he honed his skills, working his way up to chief engineer roles in various touring car and GT outfits. He possesses a keen eye for detail and a pragmatic approach to problem-solving, always seeking incremental gains in performance.

Mihai is known for his adaptability and his ability to thrive under pressure. He believes in fostering a collaborative environment within his engineering team, encouraging open communication and the sharing of ideas. His approach to engineering is rooted in a deep understanding of vehicle dynamics and a commitment to continuous improvement. He’s not one for radical, untested changes, preferring to refine existing solutions to their maximum potential.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline.
physical.description: A stocky man with a kind face and a perpetually thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on drinking his strong Romanian coffee from a chipped, lucky mug.
